This is a full list of the weapons, both small arms and vehicle mounted, found in Operation Flashpoint: Cold War Crisis, Resistance, and Elite. For the classnames of these weapons, see [[Operation Flashpoint: Weapons]].

=== Assault Rifles ===

*AK47
*AK47/GP-30
*AK74
*AK74/GP-30
*M16A2
*M16A2/M203
*XM-177E2
*XM-177S (XM-177E2 with colt scope)
*SA Vz. 58 (referred to as AK47 CZ in-game)
*AKS-74U
*H&K G36E
*Steyr AUG A1
*H&K G3A4 (''Resistance'')
*FN FAL (''Resistance'')

=== Sub-Machine Guns ===

*MP5SD3 with integrated sound suppressor
*Izhmash PP-19 Bizon with sound suppressor
*IMI Uzi with sound suppressor (''Resistance'')
*Ingram MAC-10 (''Resistance'')
*Vz. 61 Škorpion (''Resistance'')

=== Pistols ===

*CZ-75 (''Resistance'')
*Tokarev TT-33 (''Resistance'')
*Beretta 92F (''Resistance'')
*Glock 17 with or without sound suppressor (''Resistance'')
*Smith & Wesson Model 686 (''Resistance'')

=== Support Weapons ===

*M60
*PK

=== Sniper Rifles ===

*M21
*SVD Dragunov
*Remington 700 (''Resistance'')

=== Heavy Weapons ===

*M2HB Browning Machine Gun
*M72 LAW
*RPG NH-75
*Carl Gustav recoilless rifle
*AT4
*FIM-92 Stinger
*9K32 Strela-2
*MM-1
*RG-6 (referred to as ''6G30'' in-game)


=== Miscellaneous Weapons ===

*M-26 Fragmentation Grenade
*Rifle Grenade (Launched from M203 and GP-30 launchers)
*C-4 Satchel Charge
*Smoke Grenade
*Laser designator
*Anti-tank mine
*{{Link|http://www.czub.cz/index.php?p{{=}}8&lang{{=}}en|CZ584}} (referred to as ''Kozlice'' in-game)

=== Vehicle Mounted Weapons ===

*GBU-24 Laser-guided bomb
*AGM-114 Hellfire Missile
*FFAR Rocket Pods
*S-5 Rocket Pods
*AGM-65 Maverick Missile
*GAU-8 Avenger 30mm Cannon
*BGM-71 TOW Missile
*9K114 Shturm Missile
